messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick flag  CobaltWorks (renewal ~5w) dropped to ZERO inference calls starting Mon AM. They were ~22k tokens/day last week. Putting on renewal triage.
Noah Kim: Oh. Any change in billing or champion?
Priya Nair: Their ML lead moved to a different org last Friday, and procurement started an eval with ApertureAI on Tue. I see SR-12055 mentioning a security "compliance hold".
Camille Dupont: Pulled logs: no 5xx from our side. Auth events show spike of 403s at 03:10 UTC. Likely token rotation or stricter IP policy. Quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM usage WHERE account = 'cobaltworks' AND day >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC;
```
Camille Dupont: Results attached to /shared/cobaltworks/usage_snapshot.csv.
Lena Ortiz: Proposed play: 1) issue an IP-restricted short token (48h) to let their CI run, 2) offer a 30-min SE tune + 25k token credit, 3) schedule a 20-min security + infra sync to walk SAML/keys, 4) prep a tight TCO note vs Aperture. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Noah Kim: Agree. Add a minimal infra warmup snippet we can drop into outreach. Also ask AE to prepare exec note if procurement asks for pricing flex.
Priya Nair: I'll draft the outreach (<=150 words) and request the token. Keep it non-salesy: focus on unblocking tests. Camille can own perf profile and the short how-to for enabling prefix cache.
Camille Dupont: Perf note: p95 ~140ms region-us-east over last 30d. SE config to try:
```yaml
inference:
  prefix_cache: true
  batch_size: 6
  quant: fp16
```
Camille Dupont: Warmup curl for infra team:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Priya Nair: Draft outreach (short):
"Hi Jordan  noticed API traffic stopped after your recent infra changes. We can issue an IP-limited 48h token and run a 30-min SE tune to help unblock CI tests. Could we grab 20 mins this week to walk security and infra through the steps?
 Priya (CSM)"
Lena Ortiz: Ticket SR-12055 linked to renewal task CW-332. Marking priority HIGH. If usage doesn't resume within 7 days after the unblock call we escalate to AE for exec outreach.
ticket-bot: SR-12055 linked to task CW-332. Priority set to HIGH by Lena Ortiz.
Noah Kim: Camille, please upload the perf report and a 2-step infra note (<200 words) we can paste into outreach.
Camille Dupont: Perf report uploaded: /shared/cobaltworks/perf-report.pdf. Infra note drafted and attached.
Priya Nair: Outreach sent. Will update after the security sync. Closing interim thread for now.
